title: Discovery and characterization of a novel HIF-2alpha agonist for the treatment of CKD-related renal anemia.
authors: Chu, Shu-Qing; Chen, Yi-Jie; Yang, Rui-Rui; Teng, Dan; Zhou, Gui-Zhen; Zhang, Ying-Ying; Niu, Bu-Ying; Xu, Jia-Hang; Lin, Ke-Xin; Yang, Xin-Yu; Li, Xu-Tong; Zheng, Ming-Yue; Zhang, Su-Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子对接发现HIF-2α小分子激动剂，研究其与ARNT异二聚体结合及EPO转录调控，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但核心是药物发现，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factor 2-alpha (HIF-2alpha), a critical transcription factor, forms a heterodimer with aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator (ARNT) to drive the transcription of erythropoietin (EPO), a key regulator of erythropoiesis. Activation of this pathway plays a pivotal role in the treatment of anemia. By discovered structure-based virtual screening and pharmacological assays, we herein discovered an amide thiazole AT-1 that bound to HIF-2alpha with a K(D) of 2.63 muM, and enhanced the stability of the HIF-2alpha-ARNT heterodimer. Molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis analysis revealed the critical roles of His293 and Tyr307 in the binding of AT-1 to HIF-2alpha. Pharmacological studies showed that AT-1 (10, 20, 40 muM) dose-dependently enhanced both the transcription and secretion of EPO in 786-O and Hep3B cells. In zebrafish (Danio rerio), AT-1 (10 or 50 muM) exhibited favorable safety profiles and, when combined with the prolyl hydroxylase (PHD) inhibitor Molidustat (10 muM), effectively mitigated doxorubicin-induced anemia. In adenine-induced chronic kidney disease (CKD) mouse model, combined administration of AT-1 (50 mg.kg(-1).d(-1), i.p.) and Molidustat (10 mg.kg(-1).d(-1), i.p.) for 15 days produced stronger effects on increasing EPO levels and alleviating anemia than Molidustat alone, further supporting the therapeutic potential of AT-1 in CKD-related anemia.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子2-α（HIF-2alpha）作为一种关键转录因子，与芳香烃受体核转位蛋白（ARNT）形成异二聚体，驱动促红细胞生成素（EPO）的转录，后者是红细胞生成的关键调节因子。该通路的激活在贫血治疗中发挥重要作用。通过基于结构的虚拟筛选和药理学实验，我们在此发现了一种酰胺噻唑类化合物AT-1，其与HIF-2alpha的结合亲和力K(D)为2.63 μM，并增强了HIF-2alpha-ARNT异二聚体的稳定性。分子对接和定点突变分析揭示了His293和Tyr307在AT-1与HIF-2alpha结合中的关键作用。药理学研究表明，AT-1（10、20、40 μM）在786-O和Hep3B细胞中剂量依赖性地增强EPO的转录和分泌。在斑马鱼（Danio rerio）中，AT-1（10或50 μM）表现出良好的安全性，并且与脯氨酰羟化酶（PHD）抑制剂Molidustat（10 μM）联合使用时，有效缓解了多柔比星诱导的贫血。在腺嘌呤诱导的慢性肾病（CKD）小鼠模型中，AT-1（50 mg·kg(-1)·d(-1)，腹腔注射）与Molidustat（10 mg·kg(-1)·d(-1)，腹腔注射）联合给药15天，在提高EPO水平和缓解贫血方面比单独使用Molidustat产生更强效果，进一步支持了AT-1在CKD相关贫血中的治疗潜力。
